items.identity: Franz von Stuck, Die Sunde, ca. 1908, 1952.169
facts: Tempera on canvas
One of several versions painted by Stuck; Frye example belongs to the Founding Collection
items.comparison: Important as the clearest Stuck and Munich-symbolist anchor at Frye, not as a unique surviving version

items.identity: Franz von Stuck, Urteil des Paris, 1923, 1952.168
facts: Late-career mythological painting
Paris is visually subordinate to the three goddesses
items.comparison: Pairs with Sin to show Stuck shifting one theatrical system from menace to staged spectatorship

facts: Late work organized around a dancing ring
Uses bright bodies and shallow theatrical space
items.comparison: A comparative Stuck work rather than a standalone museum-defining masterpiece

facts: Early social-realist interior
The condemned man is isolated by a room of observers
items.comparison: Internationally important in Munkacsy's rise, but not claimed as a unique prison image

facts: Child blowing a soap bubble against a dark ground
Bubble imagery carries established transience associations
items.comparison: Value lies in joining precise genre painting to vanitas time, not rarity

items.identity: Fritz von Uhde, Das Bilderbuch I, 1889, 1952.174
facts: Family reading scene
Light concentrates on page and faces
items.comparison: Connects everyday naturalism to Uhde's broader sacralization of contemporary life

facts: Three trunks compress recession
Short heavy marks remain visible
items.comparison: Counters the idea that Frye founding taste depends only on polished narrative painting

facts: Birch trunks form irregular vertical rhythm
Dill was associated with the Munich Secession
items.comparison: Best used beside Trubner to distinguish two Munich landscape approaches

items.identity: Franz von Lenbach, Marion Lenbach and Daughter of Nikolaus Gysis, 1899, 1952.101
facts: Two child studies share one sheet
Completion levels differ visibly
items.comparison: A process and network document, not a top-tier formal Lenbach portrait

items.identity: Eugene Boudin, Dordrecht, The Cathedral, ca. 1885-89, 1952.009
facts: Low horizon gives most space to clouds
Painted on panel
items.comparison: Shows Frye taste extending beyond German art and values Boudin's independent weather practice

facts: Late academic nude
Surface suppresses visible brushwork
items.comparison: Useful for understanding Frye taste and the modernist rejection of academic finish, not as a rare Bouguereau

facts: Outdoor female nude in backlight
Genth built a professional reputation in a field with gendered access barriers
items.comparison: Adds authorship and access questions to the founding collection's idealized bodies

facts: Painted decades after Siahls death
Not a life portrait
items.comparison: Locally significant as a later memorial construction; must not be presented as direct visual evidence

items.identity: Louis Moeller, A Critical Point in the Game, ca. 1903, 1952.121
facts: Genre scene built around a paused chess move
Attention and gesture carry the plot
items.comparison: A strong minor example of accessible salon narrative rather than an art-historical peak

facts: Two-part oil and acrylic work
T-wall form connects body to militarized protection and displacement
items.comparison: A precise contemporary counterpoint to idealized female bodies in the Founding Collection

items.identity: Sky Hopinka, Free me from this body..., 2020, 2022.003
facts: Inkjet print on Dibond
Long handwritten title follows the blue image boundary
items.comparison: Uses Indigenous voice, land and language to expand Frye beyond representational oil painting

facts: Eight aquatint photogravures
Series structure makes repetition and gaps meaningful
items.comparison: Best understood as a complete sequence rather than elevating one print

facts: Paired archival digital prints
Fruit appears with calibration and classification devices
items.comparison: Reframes the still-life tradition through colonial archives and photographic standards

items.identity: Ellen Lesperance, We Are the Gentle Angry Women..., 2015, 2024.006.02
facts: Gouache and graphite on tea-stained paper
Knitting diagram preserves protest clothing as an action archive
items.comparison: A Pacific Northwest feminist counterpoint to women represented in the founding paintings

items.identity: Jeffry Mitchell, Not Waving, but Drowning, 2012, 2013.009
facts: Glazed earthenware on artist-made wooden pedestal
Title invokes Stevie Smith's poem about a rescue signal being misread
items.comparison: Its value comes from the friction of comic surface and emotional misreading, not rarity
